summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Site Visits and Booking Queue P1 features. All 30 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI loads correctly and displays all features. Fixed 2 bugs in booking_queue.py (NoneType concatenation errors). Mixed Content warning in frontend needs attention.

integration_issues.issue: Mixed Content errors - pages making HTTP requests instead of HTTPS for /api/projects and /api/users endpoints
integration_issues.note: The REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in .env is correctly set to HTTPS. This may be a frontend build cache issue or the env variable not being properly injected at build time.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} - accessibility improvement needed

action_items: Investigate Mixed Content issue - frontend making HTTP requests instead of HTTPS. May need to rebuild frontend or check if env variable is properly injected
Add aria-describedby to DialogContent components for accessibility

Booking Queue workflow correctly implements: waiting -> notified -> converted/expired/skipped/cancelled

SMS notifications are MOCKED - logged but not actually sent
